name: UACJ Corporation
summary: UACJ Corporation manufactures and sells aluminum products in Japan and internationally. The company offers flat rolled products, including aluminum alloy sheets for beverage containers, closures, automobiles sheets, railway rolling stocks, large ship tanks, aluminum alloy quenched sheets for aircraft, and aluminum alloy thick plates; high-conductivity materials for aluminum busbars and highly adhesive surface-treated aluminum alloy sheets; aluminum brazing sheets; EV battery housing, aluminum alloys for lithium-ion battery housing cases, current collectors, and sealing materials; bright aluminum alloy sheets; aluminum checkered plates; and lithographic sheets.
